messages:
Lina M.: heads-up, hit a weird stall+burst pattern in go-sdk onboarding sample when credential rotation is on and paginators concurrency=3. paginators hang for ~40s then a sudden spike of 429s.
Owen K.: can you paste the run command + logs?
Lina M.: run: `./examples/onboard_go --concurrency 3 --enable-rotation` then exercise 2k rows. logs: ```2025-01-09T14:02:18Z WARN auth refresh starting for client=onboard-go-3
2025-01-09T14:02:18Z INFO paginator idle waiting backoff worker=2
2025-01-09T14:02:58Z ERROR request failed status=429 route=/v1/embeds detail=rate_limit_exceeded client_window=3
2025-01-09T14:02:58Z INFO auth refresh complete token_age=0s
```
Priya S.: hmm, sounds like refresh is blocking request loop or holding locks. if background refresh pauses token-bucket drains, all workers might refill in sync and then emit a burst.
Sam R.: confirmed similar pattern in the past with Go's timed ticker + mutex around token refill. JS/Py libs do non-blocking refresh + random jitter on refill.
Owen K.: immediate mitigation we can ship: make refresh non-blocking (swap to RCU-style pointer update) + add jitter to bucket refill window. Lina can you try a local patch?
Lina M.: tried patch: changed refresh to async, added `refill_jitter_ms = 50-200`, and decreased `refill_interval_ms` from 200 -> 80. no more synchronized bursts in 10k run.
Lina M.: config snippet: ```client := redwood.NewClient(tokenProvider, redwood.ClientOptions{Concurrency:3, RefillIntervalMs:80, RefillJitterMsMin:50, RefillJitterMsMax:200})```
Priya S.: perfect. long-term we should align SDK semantics: token-bucket with per-worker reservations, background non-blocking refresh, and an opt-in strong-fairness mode for server-side quotas.
Sam R.: i'll add a cross-SDK test in devex harness that runs concurrent paginators + rotation and asserts no >N 429s/second.
build-bot: patch pushed: go-sdk/nonblocking-refresh -> ci (build 8124) :white_check_mark:
Owen K.: also can we add a short blurb in onboarding docs warning about "rotation + high concurrency" and recommended safe defaults per SDK? many customers copy the sample configs.
Lina M.: will open a docs PR and include the quick patch snippet and the reproducer. tagging @Sam R. to link test. thanks all :thumbsup:
